export_events_calendar.description: Export every current and upcoming VATSIM event as an iCalendar (.ics) feed, ready to save as a file or subscribe to from a calendar app.

mock_response.calendar:
BEGIN:VCALENDAR
VERSION:2.0
NAME:VATSIM Events
BEGIN:VEVENT
SUMMARY:Garden City to Capital City
DTSTART:20260815T070000Z
DTEND:20260815T093000Z
END:VEVENT
END:VCALENDAR

export_events_calendar.name: export_events_calendar

get_airport.description: Get an airport's entry in VATSIM's AIP: its name, IATA code, city and country, elevation, transition altitude and level, the FIR it sits in, the division that maintains it, local notes for pilots, and the controller positions that serve it.
get_airport.name: get_airport

parameters.description: The airport's four-letter ICAO code.
parameters.name: icao

get_controller.description: Get one controller who is online right now, by position callsign or VATSIM ID: their frequency, rating, visual range, how long they have been logged on and their controller info text.
get_controller.name: get_controller

parameters.description: The controller's position callsign (for example EGLL_TWR) or their VATSIM ID.
parameters.name: controller

get_event.description: Get one VATSIM event by its id: the full briefing, start and end times, the airports and suggested routes, the organising division, and the banner image.

event.description: Join us for an evening of IFR flying...
event.name: Garden City to Capital City
event.short_description: An evening of IFR flying between Christchurch and Wellington.

get_event.name: get_event

parameters.description: The event's numeric id, as returned by any of the event listing actions.
parameters.name: event_id

get_map_data.description: Get the download links for VATSIM's current airspace data: the FIR boundary files (as .dat and as GeoJSON) and the VATSpy dataset, plus the version they belong to. Use these to draw controller boundaries on a map.
get_map_data.name: get_map_data

get_member.description: Get a VATSIM member's profile by their VATSIM ID: controller rating, pilot rating, military rating, the region, division and subdivision they belong to, when they joined, and when their rating last changed.
get_member.name: get_member

parameters.description: The member's VATSIM ID (CID), the number they sign in with. For example 1234567.
parameters.name: cid

get_member_by_discord_id.description: Find the VATSIM ID behind a Discord account, for members who have linked the two in VATSIM's community portal. Returns linked as false rather than failing when there is no link, so a workflow can branch on it.
get_member_by_discord_id.display_name: Find a member by Discord ID
get_member_by_discord_id.display_str_template: Find the VATSIM member linked to Discord user {0}.
get_member_by_discord_id.name: get_member_by_discord_id

parameters.description: The Discord account's numeric user id (for example 123456789012345678), not their username.
parameters.name: discord_user_id

get_member_stats.description: Get how many hours a member has flown and controlled on VATSIM, broken down by the rating they held at the time (S1, S2, S3, C1, C3, I1, I3, supervisor and administrator).
get_member_stats.name: get_member_stats

parameters.description: The member's VATSIM ID (CID), the number they sign in with. For example 1234567.
parameters.name: cid

get_member_status.description: Check whether a member is connected to VATSIM right now, and read that connection if they are. Returns online as false rather than failing when they are offline, so a workflow can branch on it directly.
get_member_status.display_name: Check if a member is online
get_member_status.display_str_template: Check whether VATSIM member {0} is online.
get_member_status.name: get_member_status

parameters.description: The member's VATSIM ID (CID), the number they sign in with. For example 1234567.
parameters.name: cid

get_metar.description: Get the current METAR weather report VATSIM is using for one airport or several. Enter full ICAO codes such as KJFK, a prefix of one to three characters such as EG for every UK airport, or ALL for the whole world.
get_metar.name: get_metar

parameters.description: The airports to read, as ICAO codes (for example KJFK). A code of three characters or fewer is treated as a prefix, and ALL returns every airport.
parameters.name: airports

parameters.description: How many reports to return, from 1 to 10000. Defaults to 100, which matters only when you ask for a prefix or for ALL.
parameters.name: limit

get_network_summary.description: Get how busy VATSIM is right now: connected clients, unique users, and how many pilots, controllers, ATIS stations and prefiled flight plans there are. Also returns the network's reference tables for controller facilities, controller ratings, pilot ratings and military ratings.
get_network_summary.name: get_network_summary

get_pilot.description: Get one pilot who is flying on VATSIM right now, by callsign or VATSIM ID: their live position, altitude, groundspeed, heading, transponder and the flight plan they filed.

flight_plan.route: GREKI JOOPY NICSO 51N050W 52N040W DINIM ETIKI BABAN

get_pilot.name: get_pilot

parameters.description: The pilot's callsign (for example BAW178) or their VATSIM ID.
parameters.name: pilot

get_user_connections.description: Get a member's live connections as VATSIM's audio network sees them: the callsign, whether they are flying or controlling, the frequency and visual range for a controller, their position, and any secondary positions they have set. Returns online as false when they are not connected.
get_user_connections.display_str_template: Get live VATSIM connections for member {0}.
get_user_connections.name: get_user_connections

parameters.description: The member's VATSIM ID (CID), the number they sign in with. For example 1234567.
parameters.name: cid

list_airport_stations.description: List the controller positions that serve an airport (centre, approach, departure, tower, ground and delivery) with each one's callsign, name, frequency, and whether it is the unicom/CTAF frequency to use when nobody is online.
list_airport_stations.display_str_template: List controller positions for VATSIM airport {0}.
list_airport_stations.name: list_airport_stations

parameters.description: The airport's four-letter ICAO code.
parameters.name: icao

list_audio_transceivers.description: List the radio transceivers every connected client is listening and transmitting on, with each one's frequency (in hertz and in megahertz), position and height. This is what decides who can hear whom on VATSIM's voice network.
list_audio_transceivers.name: list_audio_transceivers

parameters.description: Only return records whose callsign contains this text (for example BAW for British Airways flights). Leave blank for all.
parameters.name: callsign

parameters.description: How many records to return, from 1 to 1000. Defaults to 50.
parameters.name: limit

list_countries.description: List every country VATSIM recognises, with the region, division and vACC that covers it. Pick one country to read just that record.
list_countries.name: list_countries

parameters.description: Read just this country. Leave blank to list them all.
parameters.name: country_code

list_divisions.description: List VATSIM's divisions with the region each belongs to and whether it is split into subdivisions. Pick one division to read just that record.

list_events.description: List the events running now or coming up across VATSIM, each with its start and end time, the airports and routes involved, who is organising it, the briefing and the banner image. Limit how many you get back, or narrow them to a date range.

list_fsd_servers.description: List the FSD servers pilot and controller clients connect to, with each one's hostname, location and whether it is currently accepting connections. Choose the live network, the sweatbox training servers, or both.

list_member_atc_sessions.description: List a member's past controlling sessions, newest first, each with the position worked, the times, and the session's traffic counters: aircraft tracked and seen, flight plans amended, and handoffs initiated, received and refused.

description: Read live data from VATSIM, the worldwide flight simulation network where volunteer pilots and air traffic controllers fly and staff a shared virtual sky. See who is flying and controlling right now with positions, flight plans and frequencies, read ATIS broadcasts and METAR weather, look up a member's ratings, hours, flights and controlling sessions, browse the events calendar, and read airport and airspace reference data. Free to use, with no account or API key required.
